name: Kirishima Mizuki
source:
He was the eldest son and former head of the Kirishima family. Deceased. 
His parents died young, and he became the head of the family while still a student. 
He doted on his younger brother, Kazuki, and devoted himself to keeping him away from all danger, but at the same time, he was willing to sacrifice others for Kazuki's safety. 
His hobbies were hunting and Japanese painting, and he owned a shotgun and an art studio. He occasionally held solo exhibitions during his lifetime.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/PigeonBlood]Wikipedia[/url]]
